firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently watched The Thing starts as the Leader.
clarifications: Give that player the Leader Sheet. The Leader handles the opening weather phase; character movement later begins with the player to the Leader’s left.
The same opening criterion is repeated in the separate one-to-three-player rules.
